note: bibcite_import imports bibcite_reference entities from uploaded files via bibcite_format decoders, as a batch. Its config object bibcite_import.settings has a nested settings mapping with two booleans: contributor_deduplication and keyword_deduplication (both default true). Import form /admin/content/bibcite/reference/import (permission bibcite import + administer bibcite); populate form /admin/content/bibcite/reference/populate (bibcite populate + administer bibcite); settings form route bibcite_import.settings. Medium/hard cases read/write bibcite_import.settings (router-safe config object). NOTE: actual file import is not exercised because the file decoders use the Symfony serializer, which fatals on this broken shared site; cases assert on the deduplication config values instead.

evals.prompt: In bibcite_import, which settings control whether imported authors and keywords are deduplicated against existing entities, and where are they stored?
evals.expected_output: bibcite_import.settings has settings.contributor_deduplication and settings.keyword_deduplication (both default true). When on, imported authors/keywords are matched to existing bibcite_contributor / bibcite_keyword entities rather than duplicated. Edited at /admin/config/bibcite/settings/import.

evals.prompt: How do you import a BibTeX or RIS file of references with bibcite_import, and what permission does the import form require?
evals.expected_output: Use the import form at /admin/content/bibcite/reference/import (permission 'bibcite import' plus 'administer bibcite'): upload the file, choose its format, and it batch-creates reference entities. Import formats are bibcite_format plugins whose encoder is a DecoderInterface.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is bibcite_import currently configured to deduplicate contributors (authors) when importing references? Inspect the live import settings to answer.
evals.expected_output: No - contributor deduplication is OFF: bibcite_import.settings:settings.contributor_deduplication is false (keyword deduplication remains true).

evals.prompt: Does this site's bibcite_import configuration deduplicate keywords on import? Inspect the live import settings and answer.
evals.expected_output: No - keyword deduplication is OFF: bibcite_import.settings:settings.keyword_deduplication is false.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure bibcite_import so that NEITHER contributors NOR keywords are deduplicated when importing references (both deduplication options off). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set bibcite_import.settings:settings.contributor_deduplication and settings.keyword_deduplication both to false (drush cset bibcite_import.settings settings.contributor_deduplication 0; ...keyword_deduplication 0, or via configFactory / the import settings form).

evals.prompt: When importing references on this site, I want duplicate authors to be merged but duplicate keywords to be kept separate. Configure bibcite_import so contributor deduplication is on and keyword deduplication is off. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set bibcite_import.settings:settings.contributor_deduplication to true and settings.keyword_deduplication to false.
